emptyDescription: Import an M3U or TXT playlist and its channels will appear here.
openFailedDescription: The channel library could not be opened.
noFavoritesDescription: Tap the heart on a channel card and it stays in this list.
epgSourceHint: An XMLTV or JSON guide URL
epgEmpty: No guide sources yet; import one and the channel cards show what is on.
activeGuideDescription: The guide source used for the channel list; one at a time.
activeGuideCardHint: The channel list's “on air” and progress follow this guide.
autoUpdateHint: The app checks in the background at this interval and re-fetches guides whose auto update is on.
customUserAgentDesc: The User-Agent for playlist and guide downloads and playback requests. Leave empty for the app default; a playlist line's own User-Agent wins.
autoUpdateStatusOn: {count: int} guides refresh at this interval
deleteActiveGuideNote: This guide is in use; another source takes over after deletion.
deleteGuideMessage: Delete the guide “{name: String}”? Its downloaded guide data is removed too.
deletePlaylistMessage: Delete “{name: String}” and its {count: int} channels?
importGuideDescription: XMLTV URLs or files; the guide is downloaded after import.
importInvalid: The content is not a valid playlist
importNetworkFailed: The network request failed; check the address or proxy
importPlaylistDescription: M3U/M3U8/TXT from a URL, a file or pasted text.
noSourcesDescription: Import a playlist or a guide and it appears here.
noPlaylistsDescription: Import a playlist from a URL, a file or pasted text.
playlistNameHint: Leave blank to name it from the source
replaceMessage: A playlist with this name exists; the imported content replaces it.
sourceChanged: The source changed; the cache was updated
summarySources: {playlists: int} playlists · {guides: int} guides · {channels: int} channels
orderHint: Drag the grip or use the arrows; the saved order is how the list shows.
playerNoStream: This channel has no stream address
sourceAddressOpenFailed: The address could not be opened
autoSyncDesc: Automatically check and update network resources silently when the app starts.
browseChannelNumberDesc: Prints the dial number beside the channel name.
browseReverseDesc: Makes the up key step down the list and the down key step up.
browseClockDesc: Draws the current clock beside the title while a channel plays.
browseProgrammeLineDesc: Names what is on air or coming next under the channel name.
groupsEmpty: No groups yet — import a playlist first.
groupsHint: Switching a group off takes it out of the lists and the zapping; switching it back returns the same line-up.
